acquisition.recommendation: ABANDON THIS TARGET IMMEDIATELY. This was based on a fundamental misidentification. olive.com has NOTHING to do with the defunct Olive AI healthcare startup. olive.com is owned and actively operated by Repair Ventures LLC, a legitimate Chicago-based extended car warranty company with A+ BBB rating, active Microsoft 365 email, extensive SaaS integrations (HubSpot, Salesforce, Help Scout, Google Workspace, Amazon SES), Sucuri/GoDaddy WAF security, DnsMadeEasy premium DNS, and SSL certs that were just renewed in March 2026. The domain has ALL FOUR client locks active. It has been registered since 1996 (29+ years old). This is a premium 5-letter dictionary-word .com that would cost $500K-$2M+ on the open market IF the owner were willing to sell, which they have no reason to be. The $2,923/mo ETV from DataForSEO is real — it represents the organic search traffic to an active car warranty business, NOT a defunct domain waiting to be scooped up.

what_actually_happened_with_olive_ai.oliveai_com: Sold to Waystar as part of asset sale — now 301 redirects to waystar.com. This domain is also NOT acquirable.
what_actually_happened_with_olive_ai.olive_app: Appears to be a separate company (Olive Technologies). Also NOT acquirable.
what_actually_happened_with_olive_ai.conclusion: There is no acquirable 'Olive' domain with the reported ETV. The entire premise was based on confusing olive.com (car warranty company) with Olive AI (defunct healthcare startup that used oliveai.com).

lessons_for_pipeline: DataForSEO ETV data is real but was attributed to wrong entity
Must verify that domain owner matches the 'defunct company' narrative before targeting
A domain having high ETV does NOT mean it is available — it may be an active business
Always check site:domain.com in Google before assuming a domain is dead
The Olive AI startup used oliveai.com, not olive.com — basic domain verification would have caught this
